k:絞.mnemonic: A thread (糸) left to mingle (交) with a vine winds round and round the stem, pulling tighter with every turn until the plant is squeezed like a wrung cloth. Strangle (constrict, wring).
k:絞.hint: Thread winding tighter round a stem.

k:堪.mnemonic: A dam of soil (土) packed around a roll of cloth (匹) soaked in sweet (甘) syrup and set hard as toffee. The river leans on it all winter and it does not move. Withstand (endure, support, resist).

k:帆.mnemonic: A towel (巾) tied to the mast of a mediocre (凡) little boat. It is no fine canvas, but it fills with wind and the boat moves. Sail.
k:帆.hint: Towel on a mast catching wind.

k:唄.mnemonic: A busker sings on the pier, and instead of coins the passers-by give (呉) him shellfish (貝): one clam for every verse of his long sad story. Ballad (song).
k:唄.hint: Busker paid in clams per verse.

k:挟.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) take the husband (夫) by the cheek, one on each side, and squeeze: he forgot the anniversary again. Pinch (squeeze, insert, between).

k:拍.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) dusted white (白) with flour strike together, and a white cloud puffs out on every beat of the baker's song. Clap (beat).

k:汗.mnemonic: You were dry (干) until you ran uphill from the tsunami (氵). Now water pours off you although the wave never touched you. Sweat (perspire).
k:汗.hint: Dry runner, soaked without the wave.

k:頑.mnemonic: He reads the origin (元) page (頁) of the book, page one, and refuses to turn it, quite sure the first page says everything. Foolish (stubborn, firmly).
k:頑.hint: Refusing to turn past page one.

k:肌.mnemonic: Lean your bare arm on a rough wooden table (几) for a month (月) and the grain of the wood prints itself into your skin. Texture (skin, body, grain).
k:肌.hint: Wood grain printed on an arm.

k:棚.mnemonic: Cut a tree (木) into a plank, fix it to the wall, and line up the jam on it month (月) beside month (月): January's jars next to February's. Shelf (ledge, rack, mount).
k:棚.hint: Plank with two months of jars.

k:妊.mnemonic: A woman (女) carries a little samurai (士) who may one day serve the king (王), or even be king himself. For now he is curled up inside her, waiting. Pregnancy.

k:堤.mnemonic: Soil (土) heaped along the river and patted just so (是): exactly high enough and exactly straight, so that not one drop gets over into the fields. Dike (bank, embankment).
k:堤.hint: Earth patted precisely along the river.

k:愚.mnemonic: He tries to think (思) with a hood (冂) pulled over his eyes, follows a paw print (禸) trail for miles, and proudly brings home a cocoon (厶), sure he has caught a bear. Folly (foolish, absurdity, stupid).

k:欺.mnemonic: Sweet (甘) words from a man who has spotted what you lack (欠): he promises exactly the thing you are missing, then strolls off with your purse. Deceit (cheat, delude).

k:壮.mnemonic: A samurai (士) carries a great oak plank (爿) on one shoulder as lightly as a chopstick while the bridge builders stare. Robust (manhood, prosperity).

k:貿.mnemonic: To climb out of poverty (貧), a villager carries one silk cocoon (厶) to market, swaps it for rice, and swaps the rice for two cocoons. Trade (exchange).
k:貿.hint: One cocoon swapped up at market.

k:枕.mnemonic: Your forehead (冖) sinks in, your whole body goes limp (尢), and in the morning the laundry tag (札) is printed on your cheek. Pillow.
k:枕.hint: Laundry tag printed on your cheek.

k:稼.mnemonic: Grain (禾) carried home to the house (家) at the end of every working day: sack by sack, it is what the labour has paid. Earnings (work, earn money).
k:稼.hint: Sacks of grain brought home daily.

k:畜.mnemonic: Mysterious (玄) dark shapes stand in the rice field (田) at night, breathing and chewing. At sunrise they turn out to be the farmer's cows and hens. Livestock (domestic fowl and animals).
k:畜.hint: Dark shapes chewing in the field.

k:枯.mnemonic: A tree (木) grown so old (古) that its leaves brown, its sap stops rising, and the branches turn dry and brittle. Wither (die, dry up, be seasoned).
k:枯.hint: Ancient tree going brown and brittle.

k:伐.mnemonic: Nobody brought an axe, so the leader (亻) swings a halberd (戈) at the trunk. Three strokes and the tree comes crashing down. Fell (strike, attack, punish).
k:伐.hint: Halberd swung at a tree trunk.

k:曽.mnemonic: Two dry stalks stick up from a rice field (田) that lies on top of an older day (日). Dig down a layer and you find how things once were. Formerly (once, before, ever).
k:曽.hint: An older day buried under the field.

k:逐.mnemonic: A pig (豕) has escaped down the path (辶) and the whole farm runs after it, step by step, until it is finally caught. Pursue (drive away, chase, accomplish).
k:逐.hint: Whole farm running after a pig.

k:詐.mnemonic: He will say (言) that the stick (｜) stands perfectly straight while you watch it slide (ノ) sideways and fall over. Lie (falsehood, deceive, pretend).

k:扇.mnemonic: Feathers (羽) fixed to a little door (戸) that swings back and forth on its hinge, pushing cool air at your face. Fan (folding fan).

k:瓦.mnemonic: A curved slab of fired clay seen end-on, hooked over its neighbour on the roof, with one drop of rain running down inside the curve. Tile (gram).
k:瓦.hint: Hooked clay slab with a raindrop.

k:肝.mnemonic: A whole month (月) kept dry (干), not one drink, and the organ that cleans your blood finally gets a holiday. Liver (pluck, nerve, chutzpah).
k:肝.hint: A dry month's holiday for one organ.

k:謎.mnemonic: At a fork in the path (辶) a sphinx will say (言) only this: 'Which grain of rice (米) is unlike the others?' Answer, or stay lost. Riddle (puzzle, enigma, hint).
k:謎.hint: Sphinx at the fork asks about rice.

k:唆.mnemonic: A cream cake sits on a pedestal (台). Your legs (儿) trudge (夂) past it, slow down, and turn back all on their own. Tempt (seduce, instigate, promote).
k:唆.hint: Legs turning back toward the cake.

k:釜.mnemonic: Father (父) hammers a lump of gold (金) flat (平), then beats the sheet into a deep pot an arm's length (丈) across, big enough to cook for the whole village. Kettle (cauldron, iron pot).
k:釜.hint: Father hammering out a giant pot.
